name: Central China Land Media Co., Ltd.
summary: Central China Land Media CO.,LTD, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the editing, production, and marketing of publications in China. The company publishes textbooks and supplementary teaching materials, as well as social sciences and educational guidance; and organizes planning, selects topics, collects manuscripts, and edits paper and digital textbooks, and supplementary teaching materials. It also engages in the printing and production of books, periodicals, newspapers, and other publications outside the company. In addition, it offers paper, pulp, printing machinery, and printing consumables; import and export and exhibition trade; content services through website platforms and mobile terminals; maintenance, upgrades, and training services for digital education; broadcasting, film, television programs; domestic advertising planning, agency, production and release; media operation planning, and graphic design and production; and electronic network engineering. Further, it is involved in operation and management of the editing, printing and distribution of books, periodicals, newspapers, electronic publications, audio-visual products, online publications, emerging media, framework media and other media products of affiliated enterprises; operation and management of copyright trade; publishing and leasing of primary and secondary school textbooks, printing and distribution, and research and development of college and technical secondary school textbooks; asset management, capital operation, industrial investment; cultural creativity and planning; research and development and sales of software and hardware for digital publishing, technology transfer, technical consultation and technical services; and hosting exhibitions and sales. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Jiaozuo, China. Central China Land Media CO.,LTD is a subsidiary of Central China Publishing & Media Investment Holding Group Co., Ltd.
